description: This Java class, ConceptSourceEditor, extends a generic property editor to enable serialization and deserialization of ConceptSource objects, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID within the OpenMRS system.

classes.name: ConceptSourceEditor
classes.description: A property editor class used for converting between ConceptSource objects and their string representations, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID.

methods.description: Default constructor for the ConceptSourceEditor class.
